Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The recruiting team seeks to build the culture of Stripe by aligning the strongest global talent to our highest impact business needs. They focus on bringing Stripe’s operating principles to life in their recruiting processes, providing the highest-quality candidate experience, and leveraging data driven storytelling to influence the business.

To further this important mission, we are looking for consultative and creative recruiters to grow and scale our Go-to-Market (GTM) team. The GTM organization at Stripe encompasses our Sales team, Marketing and Sales Development, GTM and Product Operations, and Professional Services.

These teams are expanding in the region, focusing on bringing new users onto the Stripe platform, supporting our existing users' scale, and growing their businesses. You can expect high impact and wide-ranging responsibilities: owning full-cycle recruiting, driving hiring strategy, and delivering best-in-class candidate experience.

This person must be a builder who thrives in a learning environment—unafraid to try new things, embrace new ideas, and welcome suggestions for how we can iterate on our processes.

Develop and execute strategic sourcing plans to identify and engage top talent, ensuring a robust and inclusive candidate pool for current and future hiring needs
Conduct regular market research and analysis to stay informed about talent trends, using insights to inform recruiting strategies and address potential challenges
Partner with senior leaders across the organization to understand their hiring objectives and develop recruiting strategies aimed at achieving headcount goals, with an emphasis on expanding our GTM teams across the US, LatAM and Canada
Track and analyze recruiting metrics, providing regular reports on hiring progress to business leadership to ensure transparency and alignment with goals
Propose and implement creative and scalable changes to the existing recruiting strategy to enhance efficacy and reach
Work closely with cross-functional teams—including Finance, People Ops, Benefits, Onboarding, and Legal—to deliver a seamless and high-quality candidate experience

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

4+ years of full-cycle Recruiting experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment including in house experience
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Strong ability to build relationships with senior leaders and effectively influence decision-making processes
Strong drive to identify and engage top talent, fostering relationships with candidates
Proven ability to utilize data insights to identify trends and refine recruiting processes, enhancing efficiency and outcomes
Flexibility, adept at shifting tasks and priorities in response to changing circumstances

Proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), such as Greenhouse, Lever, or similar platforms
Experience leveraging sourcing and CRM tools (e.g., Gem, LinkedIn Recruiter) to build and manage talent pipelines
Strong working knowledge of recruiting analytics and reporting tools to drive data-informed hiring strategies
Familiarity with scheduling, communication, and collaboration tools (e.g., GoodTime, Slack, G Suite)
Ability to quickly adopt new recruiting technologies and optimize workflows for scale

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits.

If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase .
We're hiring a Principal Recruiter to join our Core Recruiting team within People Success. This team owns hiring across Coinbase's G&A functions, and you'll be responsible for owning full-lifecycle recruiting for some of our hardest-to-fill roles. You'll partner directly with senior leaders to deeply understand their talent needs, build strong pipelines, and drive process improvements that help the recruiting team scale.

Own the full recruitment lifecycle from role intake through close for complex, senior-level searches across your Core portfolio
Build candidate pipelines through self-sourcing and competitive research, ensuring sufficient depth and quality at each stage to maintain hiring velocity
Partner with senior leaders across your client groups to translate hiring needs into effective search strategies and a strong candidate and interviewer experience
Drive data integrity and use pipeline analytics to inform hiring efficiency, surface bottlenecks, and improve outcomes for your hiring teams
Design and implement recruiting processes and pilot programs that help the team scale its impact across global markets

8+ years of full-lifecycle recruiting experience in a technology company or similarly fast-paced, high-growth environment, with demonstrated success closing senior and hard-to-attract candidates
Experience building and scaling recruiting processes across global markets
Deep knowledge across the entire candidate lifecycle, from talent mapping and sourcing through interviewing and closing
Data-driven approach to pipeline management with the ability to translate recruiting metrics into strategic recommendations for stakeholders
Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Join us in building the future of finance.
Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.
The Business Recruiting team helps Robinhood hire exceptional talent that enables our business and operations organizations to scale responsibly. The team partners closely with hiring leaders to plan hiring efforts, identify strong talent, and create a consistent candidate experience across the recruiting process. Recruiters on this team support large hiring initiatives and help ensure Robinhood continues to grow with talented, mission-driven people!
As a Recruiter, you will lead high-volume hiring efforts across our business organization, while building strong sourcing strategies and scalable recruiting workflows.

You will partner closely with hiring managers and other recruiters working on the same roles to coordinate hiring activity, maintain strong pipelines, and keep hiring processes moving efficiently.

This role requires someone who can navigate evolving priorities and high volume, introduce structure where processes may not yet exist, and use modern recruiting tools—including AI—to identify and engage top talent.
This role is based in our Chicago, IL, Menlo Park, CA, New York, NY, and Westlake, TX offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.
At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

Manage full-cycle recruiting for high-volume non-technical roles, helping teams hire efficiently while maintaining a thoughtful candidate experience
Source and engage candidates through targeted outreach, market research, and creative sourcing strategies that extend beyond traditional job boards
Coordinate closely with other recruiters working on the similar scoped roles to maintain alignment on candidate pipelines, interview progress, and hiring decisions
Establish clear recruiting workflows and processes in environments where hiring needs are evolving or newly defined
Use recruiting technology such as Greenhouse, Gem, and AI-supported tools to organize pipelines, automate workflows, and improve sourcing effectiveness

5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including experience sourcing for high-volume roles
Strong sourcing experience with a track record of identifying and engaging passive candidates
Experience using Greenhouse as an ATS and Gem to manage sourcing campaigns, pipeline tracking, and recruiting analytics
Comfort incorporating AI tools into daily recruiting workflows to improve research, sourcing, communication, and efficiency
Ability to operate effectively in environments with changing priorities and establish recruiting processes where structure may not yet exist
Strong collaboration skills and experience partnering with multiple recruiters and hiring partners working toward shared hiring goals

Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.

Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.
The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
The Opportunity
Our Talent team’s mission is to deliver exceptional hiring outcomes by creating an inclusive, engaging experience for candidates and employees alike. We identify and attract top talent, with a strong focus on early-career professionals and internal mobility.
We are hiring a Recruiter to help build our next generation of high-potential talent. You’ll focus primarily on high-volume hiring for Sales and Operations / GTM roles. You’ll own many candidate screens each day, help us scale our internal mobility culture, and bring fresh recruiting ideas to the table. If you are polished, detail-minded, motivated to build, and excited by volume + impact, this is your role.
You Will
Own full recruiting cycles — with a focus on early-career / entry-level hires
Source and engage high-potential candidates (new grads, 1–3 years’ experience) to build robust pipelines.
Conduct a high volume of candidate screens daily, while maintaining consistency and candidate experience.
Partner with hiring managers and the recruiting team to plan hiring strategies, manage priorities, and deliver results.
Monitor recruiting metrics, identify bottlenecks, and propose improvements.
Serve as an ambassador of our employer brand — design outreach campaigns, referral initiatives, etc.
Experiment with and adopt modern recruiting tools (automation, AI-assisted sourcing, outreach personalization).
You Should Have
Bachelor’s degree
2+ years of recruiting experience (in-house or agency), ideally with some exposure to high volume hiring.
Exceptional organization skills; ability to track many parallel processes without dropping balls.
Strong verbal and written communication skills — you’ll represent Flexport to many early-career candidates.
Detail orientation, especially in managing data, candidate handoffs, and feedback loops.
Comfort working with metrics and data — you’ll use them to optimize your work.
A growth mindset — you enjoy learning, adapting, and improving processes.
Experience with sourcing automation tools, personalization of outreach, or employer branding initiatives.
Why Flexport
Hands-on recruiting impact — you’ll directly shape our early-career and GTM talent pipeline.
Internal mobility focus — many of our hires transition into other roles; you’ll help map and support career paths within the company.
Cross-functional exposure — by focusing on GTM and operations, you’ll learn how different business areas run.
Modern tools + experimentation — we encourage testing new sourcing / recruiting tech (e.g. AI-assisted tools, personalization, automation) to improve velocity and quality.
Mentorship and growth — you’ll be developing under experienced recruiting leaders, with a clear path to senior recruiter / recruiting lead roles.
Culture that values feedback, creativity, and iteration — your ideas will be taken seriously, and you’ll have space to try new things.

Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

At Samsara, we hire people passionate about building for the long term. As a Senior GTM Recruiter, you'll partner with Customer Success and Revenue Operations leaders to build exceptional teams with intention, urgency, and high hiring standards. We believe the best recruiters create business outcomes—not just fill openings.

You'll influence hiring decisions with market insights and data, proactively shape talent strategy, and build high-quality pipelines before demand arises. Success is measured by the quality of hires, the trust you build with stakeholders, and the long-term impact your talent has on the business.
This is a remote role and is open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

Execute Full-Cycle Recruiting: Lead end-to-end hiring for IC and leadership roles, delivering exceptional execution from intake through offer acceptance.
Act as a Strategic Partner: Build trusted relationships with senior leaders by deeply understanding their business, challenging assumptions, and influencing hiring decisions.
Influence with Data: Analyze recruiting funnel performance, market trends, and candidate insights to identify headwinds, uncover opportunities, and proactively recommend actions that improve hiring outcomes.
Drive Proactive Talent Strategy: Build high-caliber pipelines through market mapping, long-term engagement, and talent communities—even before hiring demand exists.
Employ Creative Sourcing: Move beyond traditional sourcing by mapping talent networks and engaging exceptional candidates who aren't actively looking.
Optimize Hiring Processes: Identify bottlenecks, simplify ambiguous hiring processes, and continuously improve the candidate and hiring manager experience.
Collaborate as One Team: Foster a team-first culture by sharing talent, knowledge, and feedback to achieve the best outcomes for the business.
Apply Innovation: Leverage AI and modern recruiting tools to automate repetitive work, generate insights, and improve recruiting quality and efficiency.

8+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including ownership of high-bar roles with hard-to-close profiles across multiple disciplines
Proven track record of successfully hiring GTM talent, including Customer Success Managers, Implementation Consultants, Solutions Engineers, Sales Operations, and Revenue Operations roles.
Demonstrated success running searches for senior stakeholders (Director level and above), with an emphasis on trust, rigor, and influence
A “Talent Partner” mindset—you contribute insights, talent data, and structure that raise the bar beyond filling roles
Experience hiring in innovative and high-bar companies
Proven ability to build effective outbound and passive talent strategies in constrained markets - especially where the "easy path" doesn’t work
Strong track record of navigating complex hiring scenarios, including pushback, ambiguity, and process risk, while keeping a long-term focus on hiring quality
Excellent communicator who aligns stakeholders, mitigates surprises, and delivers crisp execution
Experience leveraging AI tools thoughtfully and intentionally to drive more thorough, effective, and efficient recruiting - without compromising candidate quality or experience.

Total Rewards
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders.

Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company.

We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working
At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements.

For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements.

Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
Belonging at Samsara
At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law.

We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Ericsson is looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner – Early Careers (Intern & Co-op), based in Ottawa, to support intern and co-op hiring across Canada and the United States. This role is central to delivering high-quality early talent hiring outcomes through close collaboration with hiring managers, universities, and internal stakeholders.

The successful candidate will manage end-to-end recruitment for intern and co-op positions, ensuring a seamless experience for both candidates and hiring managers while maintaining compliance with Canadian and US hiring requirements. This is a full-time, experienced-level position based in Ottawa.

Manage full-cycle recruitment for intern and co-op roles across Canada and the US
Collaborate with hiring managers to define hiring needs, timelines, selection criteria, and structured interview plans
Lead intake meetings and shape recruitment strategy for early careers hiring
Source and attract early talent through university partnerships, campus programs (with a strong focus on Canadian and/or US institutions), job boards, talent platforms, and internal pipelines
Screen and assess candidates to build strong, diverse shortlists
Coordinate high-volume interview processes and deliver an excellent candidate experience
Ensure compliance with Canada and US job posting requirements, including pay transparency and sponsorship language
Partner with Talent Acquisition Operations and HR on offers, onboarding, and hiring documentation
Track and report on key recruiting metrics such as time-to-fill, conversion rates, and pipeline health
Contribute to the continuous improvement of early careers hiring programs and processes

3–6 years of recruiting experience, in-house or at an agency
Experience hiring for intern, co-op, or early careers roles
Ability to manage multiple high-volume requisitions simultaneously
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills
Experience working across Canadian and/or US markets
Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (e.g., SuccessFactors, Eightfold, SmartRecruiter)
Strong organizational and project management skills
Experience with diversity hiring or early talent pipeline development

Du weißt, wie Recruiting wirklich funktioniert. Wir bauen die Infrastruktur dafür.
Bei selectry suchen wir nicht einfach jemanden, der Stellen besetzt. Wir suchen jemanden, der Recruiting als strategische
Disziplin versteht und Lust hat, das in einem Umfeld zu leben, in dem AI-Technologie und menschliche Recruiting-Expertise
Hand in Hand gehen.
Über uns
selectry ist ein AI-powered HR Tech Startup mit Sitz in Berlin. Wir helfen Unternehmen, die richtigen Talente schneller zu finden durch intelligente Automatisierung, strukturierte Prozesse und ein Candidate-Matching-System, das funktioniert.
Was uns unterscheidet: Wir bauen nicht nur Recruiting-Prozesse. Wir automatisieren sie mit KI-Agenten, die den gesamten
Funnel abdecken. Vom Intake über die Suchstrategie bis zur Vorqualifikation. Du arbeitest bei uns nicht trotz Technologie,
sondern mit ihr.
Unser Team ist klein, fokussiert und wächst bewusst. Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege, viel Eigenverantwortung und echte Mitgestaltungsmöglichkeiten.
Deine Aufgaben
Full-Cycle Recruiting: Du steuerst den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess eigenverantwortlich, von der ersten Identifikation geeigneter Kandidat:innen bis zur Vertragsunterzeichnung
Active Sourcing: Du nutzt LinkedIn Recruiter und weitere Kanäle für gezielte, personalisierte Direktansprache und du weißt, wie man komplexe Suchstrategien entwickelt und umsetzt
Talentpool-Aufbau: Du denkst über die aktuelle Stelle hinaus und baust nachhaltige Talentpools auf, die langfristig Wert liefern
Kompetenzbasierte Interviews: Du führst strukturierte Interviews nach Kompetenzmodellen und bewertest Kandidat:innen fundiert und nachvollziehbar
KPI-gesteuertes Recruiting: Du analysierst relevante Recruiting-Kennzahlen, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und setzt Maßnahmen um
Candidate Experience: Du sorgst dafür, dass jede Interaktion mit selectry als Arbeitgeber einen positiven Eindruck hinterlässt – von der ersten Ansprache bis zur Entscheidung
Hiring-Manager-Beratung: Du berätst interne Stakeholder zu Anforderungsprofilen, Marktlage und Recruiting-Strategie auf Augenhöhe, nicht als Dienstleister

How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. You will join selectry as a Senior Recruiter and run end-to-end searches through our Hiring Engine for our clients. You own the process from structured intake to signed offer, use data to improve it, and build the sourcing infrastructure that makes the next search faster than the one before.
Why this role exists
selectry is a Berlin-based hr-tech company. We build and operate the Hiring Engine for plannable recruiting. Our three product lines cover different levels of recruiting ownership for our clients. What they share is a common requirement: searches need to be run well, documented clearly, and improved continuously.
We are a small, senior team. Decisions move quickly. The work is concrete. We run our own searches and source proactively rather than relying on inbound volume. We source, assess, and advise, and we document every step.
This role exists because the Hiring Engine needs an experienced recruiter who can carry searches independently, consult clients and hiring managers with evidence and clarity, and help build the sourcing and process infrastructure that makes selectry's output reliable and repeatable.
What you will work on
Own the full recruiting lifecycle across client searches, from intake and role clarification through active sourcing, structured assessment, and offer management to signed contract
Design and run multi-channel sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter, XING, and direct outreach, including complex Boolean search and talent mapping for specialist and leadership profiles
Build and maintain talent pools of passive candidates across the segments selectry searches most frequently, structured, auditable, and ready for the next search
Conduct structured, competency-based interviews and advise hiring managers on evaluation criteria, profile fit, and decision quality
Track, analyse, and report on recruiting KPIs, including time-to-hire, time-to-fill, funnel conversion, and source-of-hire, and use the data to improve the process at every stage
Create and maintain search briefs, outreach templates, and interview guides within selectry's documentation infrastructure
Lead employer branding projects for selectry itself, for example career page content, candidate experience improvements, and outreach standards
Must-haves
Strong experience in recruiting, with end-to-end ownership of complex, specialist, or leadership hiring processes from sourcing through to offer
Hands-on active sourcing experience with LinkedIn Recruiter and multi-channel direct outreach, including the ability to design Boolean search strategies and talent maps independently
Experience building and maintaining structured talent pools for passive candidate segments using a CRM or ATS
Experience conducting competency-based candidate interviews and advising hiring managers on evaluation frameworks and profile decisions
KPI literacy: you have tracked recruiting data and used it to change a process, with a concrete example you can explain
German at C2 level and English at minimum C1, both required from day one, as searches run in both languages
Reliable self-management in a remote setup, careful documentation, and clear written communication
Nice-to-haves
Background in sales recruiting, executive search, or specialist/leadership hiring in a B2B or technology environment
Delivered employer branding work with concrete outputs, for example employer value proposition (EVP) development, career page content, candidate experience design, or career fair coordination
Familiarity with mid-market ATS or CRM-based recruiting platforms, for example Personio, Greenhouse, or Recruitee
Familiarity with the DACH talent market and its sourcing dynamics, particularly for niche or hard-to-fill profiles
How we work
selectry is fully remote within Germany, with our registered office in Berlin. The team is deliberately small so decisions are made quickly and work stays concrete. We use documented playbooks, clean process logic, and a tooling setup.
Technology supports the work. Humans verify and decide. That applies to how we run our product and to how we work internally.
There are no vanity metrics here. A good search is one where the right person was found, the process was fair, and the documentation lets us learn from it.

About Your Employment. Taktile operates through regional entities worldwide. The applicable entity will be confirmed during the offer process.
Your Privacy . Taktile (“we” or “us”) is the controller of the personal data you provide during this application process. We collect and process your name, contact details, resume/CV, work history, education, and any other information you submit or that we obtain from publicly available sources or references.
How we use your data: We process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy, communicate with you about the recruitment process, comply with legal obligations (such as right-to-work verification), and, with your consent, to consider you for future opportunities.
Legal basis (EU/UK applicants): We rely on (i) pre-contractual steps at your request (GDPR/UK GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)), (ii) legal obligations (Art. 6(1)(c)), and (iii) our legitimate interest in evaluating candidates (Art. 6(1)(f)).
Retention: If your application is unsuccessful, we retain your data for 12 months after the recruitment process concludes, unless you consent to longer retention. Successful candidates’ data becomes part of their employment records.
Your rights: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the processing of your personal data, to data portability, and to withdraw consent. California residents have additional rights under the CCPA, including the right to know, delete, and correct personal information.

s.h: BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
s.t:
At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.
Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you .
We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you.

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.
This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.
Depending on where you are located, you may have the right to request further information about how AI is used in our recruitment process, to opt out of AI-assisted review, to request a manual review of any decision made or to contest a decision.

Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

As a technical recruiter on our R&D team, you will drive full-cycle recruiting for open software engineering roles. In this fast-paced role, you will manage an active load of requisitions, guiding candidates through the hiring process with clarity, speed, and a commitment to quality.
We are looking for someone who is eager to build a career in technical recruiting, highly collaborative, and motivated to learn. You will have access to structured mentorship, supportive leadership, and real-time feedback to help you refine your skills. The candidates who thrive at Samsara are curious, adaptable, and focused on delivering a great experience for candidates and hiring managers alike.
This role is open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

Own full-cycle recruiting: Manage the hiring process for software engineering roles from intake through offer
Execute with efficiency: Keep candidates moving through the process with clear communication, operational discipline, and consistent follow-through
Source proactively: Build diverse candidate pipelines using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, and targeted sourcing strategies
Partner with hiring managers: Run structured intake calls, align on candidate profiles, and maintain transparent communication throughout each search
Deliver an exceptional candidate experience: Represent Samsara with timely updates, clear next steps, and respectful communication at every stage
Use data to improve: Track pipeline metrics to identify bottlenecks and refine your sourcing and screening approach
Apply feedback quickly: Work closely with senior recruiters and managers to continually develop your recruiting skillset
Leverage AI thoughtfully: Use AI-based tools and recruiting technology to streamline repetitive tasks while maintaining a high-touch candidate experience

2-5 years of full-cycle recruiting experience (agency or in-house), with software engineering recruiting experience preferred
Proven ability to manage multiple open requisitions in a fast-paced environment
Strong communication skills with candidates and internal team members
Demonstrated growth mindset with a desire to seek out and act on constructive feedback
Proficiency with sourcing tools, including LinkedIn Recruiter and modern applicant tracking systems
Passion for building a long-term career in technical recruiting
The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Total Rewards
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders.

Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company.

We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working
At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements.

For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements.

Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
Belonging at Samsara
At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law.

We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

**RH de A à Z - avec la responsabilité de vos propres sites**
Nous sommes cross-ING - une jeune entreprise d'ingénierie suisse indépendante, certifiée ISO 9001/13485. Nos collaborateurs sont notre facteur clé de succès. C'est pourquoi nous ne considérons pas les RH uniquement comme une administration, mais comme un partenaire important pour nos cadres. Nous avons des responsables de site dans 12 sites différents en Suisse.
Dans le cadre du développement de notre organisation RH, nous recherchons un/une
**Spécialiste RH 50-60%**
pour notre centre d'opérations à Winterthur.
**Votre rôle**
Avec vos deux collègues, vous gérez de manière globale les sites qui vous sont attribués. Cela signifie : vous accompagnez les collaborateurs et les cadres **de la première demande de recrutement jusqu'au départ** et êtes la personne de contact centrale pour toutes les questions RH de vos sites.
Vous apportez votre expérience RH jusqu'à présent et assumez progressivement plus de responsabilités. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec nos responsables de site et êtes soutenu(e) par nos assistants RH & recrutement dans le recrutement opérationnel.
**Vos tâches**
**Recrutement**
* Conseil aux responsables de site sur les besoins en personnel et les profils requis
* Accompagnement et coordination du processus de recrutement de vos sites
* Évaluation et priorisation des candidatures reçues
* Collaboration avec les responsables de site pour la sélection des candidats appropriés
* Accompagnement professionnel et communication avec les candidats
* Création et entretien d'un vivier de candidats
* Assurer un processus de recrutement efficace et rapide
* Collaboration avec nos assistants RH & recrutement pour la gestion opérationnelle
* Accompagnement des candidats jusqu'à l'embauche réussie
**Gestion RH**
* Gestion globale de vos sites et collaborateurs attribués
* Soutien et conseil aux responsables de site sur les questions de personnel
* Rédaction et gestion des contrats de travail
* Accompagnement des entrées et sorties
* Traitement des mutations et autres processus RH
* Accompagnement des collaborateurs tout au long de leur cycle de vie professionnel
* Participation aux projets RH et au développement de nos processus RH
**Organisation RH**
* Entretien et développement de nos processus RH
* Travail avec notre outil de recrutement **Recruitee** et d'autres systèmes RH
* Assurer une haute qualité des données
* Collaboration avec la paie et les autres fonctions RH
* Remplacement au sein de l'équipe RH
**Vous correspondez à notre profil si vous**
* avez une formation ou une formation continue dans le domaine des RH
* avez acquis une première expérience professionnelle en RH
* appréciez une fonction RH polyvalente avec un contact direct avec les cadres et les collaborateurs
* souhaitez non seulement gérer le recrutement administrativement, mais aussi y participer activement
* avez un bon sens des personnes et des situations
* travaillez de manière autonome, structurée et orientée solutions
* aimez prendre des responsabilités tout en étant prêt(e) à apprendre de nouvelles choses
* gardez une vue d'ensemble même avec plusieurs sujets parallèles
* vous sentez à l'aise dans un environnement dynamique et entrepreneurial
* avez d'excellentes connaissances en allemand et comprenez bien l'anglais
**Ce qui vous attend chez nous**
Chez cross-ING, vous n'êtes pas simplement responsable de certains processus RH. Vous **gérez vos sites de manière globale** et pouvez ainsi établir des relations à long terme avec les cadres et les collaborateurs. En même temps, vous faites partie d'une petite équipe RH polyvalente où nous nous soutenons mutuellement et assurons les remplacements.

Ce poste vous offre la possibilité d'apporter votre expérience RH jusqu'à présent et de **prendre progressivement plus de responsabilités**. Vous n'avez pas besoin de tout savoir dès le départ - ce qui compte pour nous, c'est que vous soyez curieux(se), que vous aimiez apprendre et que vous ayez plaisir à vous développer.

* une fonction RH polyvalente avec une responsabilité de A à Z
* vos propres sites et interlocuteurs directs
* la possibilité de découvrir et de façonner l'ensemble du cycle de vie des employés
* beaucoup de marge de manœuvre pour le développement de nos processus RH
* des voies de décision courtes et un environnement entrepreneurial
* une équipe RH collégiale
* des possibilités de travail flexibles
* un temps partiel d'environ 50-60%
**Vous souhaitez gérer les RH de manière globale, participer activement au recrutement et être proche du business ? Vous souhaitez prendre des responsabilités et vous développer professionnellement ?** **Alors nous nous réjouissons de faire votre connaissance.** Les candidatures des agences de placement ne seront pas prises en compte.

About the Role: The Senior Talent Acquisition Partner is a sourcing-first recruiter and strategic advisor to hiring leaders, anchored in EMEA GTM hiring (Sales, Marketing, Customer Success) and built to flex as a utility player wherever the business needs coverage next.

Your primary focus is finding and closing GTM talent across EMEA before it's actively looking; secondly you’ll be picking up other departments and levels when volume, timing, or gaps require it.

You'll operate inside an AI-forward TA function, using Findem for talent intelligence and outbound sourcing, Ashby as our core Applicant Tracking System, and BrightHire for interview signals, to move faster and with better data than a traditional recruiting model allows.
This role directly shapes how Camunda builds its EMEA GTM engine and is a proof point for what a modern, sourcing-led TA function looks like in the region.

Own EMEA GTM hiring end-to-end , acting as a strategic advisor to Sales and Customer Success leaders on market realities, compensation structures, notice periods, and candidate expectations across different countries - and shaping hiring plans before reqs are even opened
Build proactive sourcing pipelines in Findem , surfacing GTM talent in untapped markets before they're actively looking, with regular market intelligence shared back to hiring leaders
Keep our hiring infrastructure clean and disciplined: use Ashby as our system of record with accurate stages and active scorecards; use BrightHire consistently to capture interview signal and coach hiring teams on feedback quality
Be the trusted point of contact hiring leaders reach out to for updates - not the other way around - while also flexing into other EMEA departments and levels when the business needs coverage without losing sourcing rigor
Partner directly on role scope and market strategy with EMEA hiring leaders before job descriptions are finalized, helping them hire smarter and faster
Report pipeline health and sourcing effectiveness to business leadership with a regular cadence, making GTM pipeline visibility a standing metric
Create a candidate experience that is fast , transparent, and consistent with a company operating at Camunda's pace

6+ years of full-cycle recruitment at a high-growth, scaling SaaS company with direct experience owning EMEA or multi-country hiring at scale
Proven track record recruiting GTM talent (Sales, Marketing, or Customer Success) across EMEA - with working knowledge of compensation structures, notice periods, and candidate expectations by country
A sourcing-first mindset: you can point to candidates you found and hired, not just candidates you processed through a pipeline
Experience partnering with hiring leaders as an advisor and strategist, shaping role scope and market strategy - not just fulfilling requisition requests
A solutions-driven, high-pace mindset suited to a company still building its operating model, with comfort operating autonomously in a remote, distributed environment

Direct experience with Ashby, Findem, or BrightHire (or similar recruiting stack tools)
Experience operating in an AI-forward or AI-augmented TA function
Fluency in a European language beyond English
Track record as a utility player - GTM as your anchor but proven ability to pick up other departments and levels without a long ramp

## Description de l'entreprise ##
Avec plus de 13'000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices représentant 160 métiers, les Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève (HUG) sont un établissement de référence au niveau national et international. Pour en savoir plus sur notre institution, prenez quelques minutes pour consulter notre rétrospective 2025 en cliquant-ici.
La Direction des Ressources Humaines a pour principale mission d-assurer le développement du capital humain de l-institution en perspective de l-évolution organisationnelle. La politique RH des HUG se fonde sur le développement des compétences et des parcours professionnels en adéquation avec les besoins institutionnels et se concentre sur la prise en compte de la personne, de l-équilibre vie professionnelle/vie privée et de la santé et sécurité au travail.
Le Département diagnostique, composé de neuf services médicaux, a pour mission de fournir des diagnostics, produits thérapeutiques, actes thérapeutiques, et consultations cliniques spécialisées, de haute qualité médicale, dans les meilleurs délais et à un coût acceptable, pour orienter la prise en charge de la patientèle et contribuer aux décisions et gestes thérapeutiques.
## Description du poste ##
Secondant la responsable des ressources humaines du département médical, vous renseignez et conseillez les collaborateurs et collaboratrices et les cadres sur les questions RH et vous assumez la gestion administrative pour le public cible dont vous êtes responsable, ceci en synergie avec deux collègues gestionnaires RH.

Ainsi, vous intervenez au plan administratif sur tout le cycle de vie de nos équipes, du recrutement au départ, et en lien avec de nombreux partenaires de la DRH et de l-institution (service salaire et assurances sociales, service recrutement, managers médico-soignants et techniques, -).
Vous garantissez, par délégation de la responsable des ressources humaines, l'organisation et la gestion des activités liées au traitement des dossiers tout en veillant à une juste répartition des priorités. Vous coordonnez les prestations RH selon les règles et directives de la DRH en représentant la politique des ressources humaines institutionnelles.
Vous apportez du soutien à votre responsable dans le développement d-un climat de travail harmonieux et respectueux des personnes.
Personne orientée service clients et solutions, vous vous reconnaissez par ailleurs dans les valeurs des HUG que vous incarnez dans l-exercice de vos fonctions.

Vous êtes titulaire d-un CFC d-employé ou employée de commerce ou d'une formation jugée équivalente dans le domaine des sciences humaines, de la gestion d'entreprise hôtelière ou des sciences économiques, et vous avez obligatoirement complété votre formation initiale par le certificat de gestionnaire RH.
Vous bénéficiez d-une expérience professionnelle de trois à cinq ans minimum dans une fonction similaire. La connaissance du milieu médical et/ou du secteur public genevois est un atout. Votre expérience vous a conduit à développer un sens de la discrétion et de la confidentialité ainsi qu'une grande faculté d'organisation.
Vous avez une très bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques usuels tels que Word, Excel, PowerPoint et Outlook mais aussi des outils collaboratifs (Sharepoint, Teams, -).
Vous maîtrisez parfaitement la langue française tant à l-oral qu-à l-écrit.
Personne flexible, rigoureuse, organisée et dotée d-un bon sens relationnel, vous savez travailler en équipe et développer des relations harmonieuses avec vos interlocutrices et interlocuteurs en faisant preuve de diplomatie et d-entregent.
Enfin vous êtes capable de gérer un important volume de travail et de fixer des priorités.

About Halter
At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences.

Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance.

Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

As a key member of the Talent team, you’ll play a hands-on role in attracting, sourcing, and hiring world-class talent to support our business as we scale globally. You’ll work closely with hiring managers to understand their team needs, anticipate upcoming roles, and manage end-to-end recruitment processes that ensure we bring in exceptional people who align with our mission and values.
Reporting to the Talent Lead, GTM & Customer, you’ll own recruitment across our customer teams, an always-on, high-volume hiring space critical to Halter’s success. You’ll focus on building and maintaining strong pipelines of talent across Customer Support, Customer Onboarding and Fleet teams ensuring we consistently hire the best people to deliver an outstanding experience to our farmers and ranchers.
You’ll execute recruitment strategies, manage proactive talent pools, and deliver a world-class candidate experience that reflects the calibre of our product, our team, and our culture. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, enjoys partnering closely with teams across the business, and is energised by high-volume, high-impact hiring.
If you love pace, ownership, and building scalable recruitment processes, this is the role for you.

About Ramp
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

At Ramp, people are the single biggest lever on our trajectory, and the bar for who joins this team gets higher every quarter, not lower. We are hiring our first dedicated Recruiter for GTM Expansion, based in London: someone who can map a market, identify the operators who will outperform their peers and run a full-cycle process that wins them.
The UK is the immediate mandate. You will partner with local and US-based leaders to turn an ambitious growth plan into a real commercial team, from first conversation through offer close. You will also help us build the recruiting approach, market knowledge and candidate networks that support Ramp's expansion into new GTM markets over time.
The recruiters who do this best combine craft on the front end, research, identification and calibration, with execution on the back end, closing, candidate experience and pipeline discipline. We are looking for both.

· Own full-cycle recruiting for priority GTM Expansion hiring, starting with UK roles across Sales, Solutions Consulting, Partnerships and Customer Success.

· Build a sharp point of view on the UK market and future expansion markets: the companies producing strong talent, the people who outperform their peers and the communities that matter.

· Use research, data and AI as part of your everyday craft to identify and qualify exceptional candidates. We expect a written market point of view, not just a slate of profiles.

· Run thoughtful, personalised outreach grounded in the candidate's actual background, commercial motion or recent work. We care more about quality, replies and conversion than send volume.

· Partner with GTM leaders to turn ambitious hiring plans into a clear profile, credible process and realistic compensation strategy. Surface hard market truth early and push back constructively when needed.

· Own the candidate experience from first conversation through offer close: fast follow-up, clear communication, strong process discipline and a tailored closing plan for the candidates we most want.

· Build real presence for Ramp in London through the right relationships, referrals and targeted community activity. The point is pipeline and credibility, not events for their own sake.

· Work tightly with the wider GTM Recruiting team on calibration, sourcing support, insight and operating rhythm, while bringing strong local judgment.

· Help improve how Ramp recruits for expansion by capturing what works in the UK and applying it thoughtfully as we enter new markets.
What You Need

· 5+ years of full-cycle GTM or Sales recruiting experience, ideally in a high-growth technology company where quality and pace both mattered.

· Strong knowledge of the UK technology talent market and a credible local network, or clear evidence that you can build one quickly.

· A track record of finding and closing exceptional people, not simply running inherited processes. You can point to candidates you identified who became strong hires.

· Excellent sourcing and research instincts. You can explain why someone is genuinely differentiated, not only that they have the right title at the right company.

· Experience hiring across several GTM functions, such as AEs, Sales Leadership, Solutions Consulting, Partnerships, Customer Success or RevOps.

· Strong candidate-closing judgment. You listen closely, understand what each candidate is weighing and can build conviction against serious alternatives.

· The confidence to influence senior leaders, challenge a mis-scoped search and make a hiring process better without creating unnecessary friction.

· Comfort using data to understand funnel health, diagnose problems and hold an honest conversation about what needs to change.

· High ownership. You book the next step while you have the candidate, chase what is stuck and do not wait for a detailed brief to get useful work moving.

· Specific, sharp written communication. Your outreach and candidate updates should never feel template-driven.

· Experience recruiting for a fintech, SaaS, infrastructure or similarly complex B2B product.

· Experience joining a company as the first recruiter in a new geography, or helping to scale an international business.

· Experience building an AI-augmented recruiting research workflow.
Why this Role
You will have unusual ownership over one of Ramp's most important growth priorities, with the support of an established Talent team rather than the isolation of a one-person recruiting function. The work is practical and high impact: build the UK commercial team, help leaders make better hiring decisions and raise the bar for how Ramp recruits as it enters new markets.

How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. Ein weiterer wichtiger Bestandteil deiner Tätigkeit ist die kontinuierliche Rekrutierung neuer Fachkräfte. Du führst Bewerbungsgespräche, baust einen starken Kandidatenpool auf und sorgst dafür, dass Vakanzen jederzeit zeitnah und qualitativ hochwertig besetzt werden können.

We are seeking a Talent Acquisition Partner : an individual who is passionate about enabling a product-led organisation by engaging and hiring talented members across all different Business areas.

Own hiring end-to-end, from intake through offer, across the Business as your primary area of depth.
Work as a peer to hiring managers and GTM leadership: run intakes that sharpen unclear requirements, push back when a profile isn't hireable, calibrate on candidates, and hold the process to a standard when timelines get tight.
Develop sourcing strategies for talent that rarely applies passive outreach, Boolean, referrals, networking, and competitive intelligence across travel tech, marketplaces, and B2B SaaS.
Maintain pipelines for critical and recurring roles, so we're not starting from zero each time a req opens.
Coach hiring managers on interviewing and keep our assessment consistent as teams grow.
Use hiring data, funnel conversion, time-to-hire, and source effectiveness to change how we hire, not just to report on it.
Keep the ATS accurate and support employer branding in the communities we hire from.

At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.
Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you .
We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.
This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about technical talent acquisition, has a strong track record of sourcing high-quality developers, and can drive recruitment strategies with autonomy and creativity.

Lead end-to-end recruitment processes for developer and engineering roles, from screening resumes and conducting technical interviews to managing candidate pipelines across Cyprus.
Source high-quality developer candidates through diverse channels, including job boards, social media, networking events, and proactive outreach in the Cyprus tech market.
Manage and optimize our ATS (Applicant Tracking System) to ensure accurate record-keeping and organizational efficiency throughout the hiring process.
Provide timely, constructive feedback to candidates at every stage of the recruitment process, ensuring a seamless and positive candidate experience.
Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with engineering hiring managers to understand their technical hiring priorities and provide strategic recruitment support.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of recruitment processes and procedures, offering insights and best practices to enhance efficiency and quality.
Stay informed about developer talent market trends in Cyprus and the wider region, technical recruitment best practices, and competitive insights to adapt our recruitment strategies accordingly.

2-3 years of experience in recruitment, preferably within a fast-paced, tech-driven company.
Proven experience working with popular ATS platforms such as Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, etc.
Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple requisitions simultaneously.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage and build relationships with candidates and internal stakeholders.
A proactive, resourceful approach to sourcing and recruiting, with experience in building talent pipelines.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
Passion for talent acquisition, a keen eye for detail, and a commitment to delivering an exceptional candidate experience.
Experience recruiting internationally is a plus.
Fluency in written and verbal communication in English.
Location

🚀 About WRITER
WRITER is where the world's leading enterprises orchestrate AI-powered work. Our vision is to expand human capacity through superintelligence. And we're proving it's possible – through powerful, trustworthy AI that unites IT and business teams together to unlock enterprise-wide transformation.

With WRITER's end-to-end platform, hundreds of companies like Mars, Marriott, Uber, and Vanguard are building and deploying AI agents that are grounded in their company's data and fueled by WRITER's enterprise-grade LLMs.

Valued at $1.9B and backed by industry-leading investors including Premji Invest, Radical Ventures, and ICONIQ Growth, WRITER is rapidly cementing its position as the leader in enterprise generative AI.
Founded in 2020 with office hubs in San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, Austin, Chicago, and London, our team thinks big and moves fast, and we're looking for smart, hardworking builders and scalers to join us on our journey to create a better future of work with AI.

As a go-to-market (GTM) sales recruiter, you'll play a pivotal role in scaling the sales engine that powers WRITER's growth. You'll be responsible for sourcing, screening, and hiring exceptional enterprise and strategic candidates who align with our company values and contribute to our growth objectives.

This is a high-impact role — the people you bring in will be the ones closing deals with the world's leading enterprises, expanding our footprint, and helping us cement our position as the leader in enterprise generative AI.
We're growing fast, and our GTM team is at the center of that growth. You'll partner closely with hiring managers across sales to understand their needs, build targeted sourcing strategies, and deliver a seamless candidate experience that makes top talent excited to join WRITER. Your work will directly shape the revenue org that takes our platform to hundreds more companies.
This is a 6-month contract role based in our San Francisco or New York City offices, with the option for a hybrid or remote setup. You’ll report to the VP, talent.

Proactively source and engage with passive candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, and professional networks to build a steady pipeline of top GTM talent
Conduct initial phone screens and interviews to assess candidates' qualifications, cultural fit, and alignment with our company values
Partner closely with hiring managers and stakeholders to understand their hiring needs and provide regular updates on the recruitment process
Own the full recruitment lifecycle from job posting to offer negotiation, ensuring a seamless and positive candidate experience at every step
Leverage recruitment metrics and data to optimize the hiring process, identify trends, and make informed decisions that improve quality of hire and time to fill
Shape and contribute to our employer branding efforts by creating compelling job descriptions, promoting our company culture, and enhancing our presence on social media and job boards
Drive hiring velocity across a growing sales org, managing multiple open roles simultaneously without compromising on quality
⭐️ What you need
5+ years of proven experience in a recruiting role within a fast-paced, tech-driven environment, with a focus on go-to-market functions
Strong sourcing skills with proficiency in using various sourcing tools and techniques to identify and engage with top talent
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build rapport with candidates and stakeholders alike
Strong time management and organizational abilities, with a keen attention to detail and the ability to juggle multiple priorities
A data-driven mindset with the ability to analyze recruitment data and use insights to drive process improvements
A collaborative nature with a proven ability to work effectively in a team environment and build strong relationships with stakeholders
Must have experience working within a SaaS environment, with a genuine excitement for AI and the opportunity to help build the future of work
A passion for WRITER's values — you Connect with candidates and teammates authentically, Challenge the status quo to raise the hiring bar, and Own outcomes end to end

Rocket Lab’s People & Culture team is responsible for looking after our most valuable asset : our people . Across our global teams , the People & Culture team supports our people and departments across recruitment , new staff orientation , compensation , training and development .

They make sure our growing and diverse global team is supported and capable of delivering our projects and customer’s missions , and they’re responsible for supporting their development , nurturing their skills and talent , and retaining the world-class people already on our team .

We’re building a newly formed, high‑performing Talent Acquisition team, pushing boundaries, raising the bar, and redefining recruitment at Rocket Lab. We work fast, trust each other, and deliver. To match our pace and ambition, we’re hiring a Talent Acquisition Partner with proven ability to recruit world‑class technical engineering and aerospace talent.
You’ll operate in a highly technical, fast‑moving environment, partnering with hiring managers who rely on your guidance and expertise to navigate complex engineering requirements. Proven technical engineering or aerospace recruitment experience is essential, the complexity and speed of the work demand it.
You’ll influence hiring decisions, advocate for exceptional candidates, manage shifting priorities, and maintain momentum. This role demands the Rocket Lab hustle: moving fast, solving creatively, adapting instantly, and delivering when it matters most.

5+ years of recruitment experience
Proven technical engineering or aerospace recruitment experience, essential
Success sourcing hard‑to‑find technical talent through multiple channels
Experience from either agency or in‑house recruitment
Strong relationship building, hiring managers and candidates trust you because you deliver
Ability to manage conflicting, urgent priorities in a fast‑moving environment
Creative problem‑solving and adaptability when plans shift
A collaborative mindset, you thrive in a high‑trust, high‑performing team
The Rocket Lab hustle, urgency, resilience, and a drive for results

s.h: WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW BEFORE APPLYING
s.t:
You don’t go to Mars working eight to five, Monday to Friday. The lights are always on at Rocket Lab because the work we do matters. When a launch window opens, we go. When a customer needs us, we deliver. When the mission calls, we answer.
This isn’t a role for someone seeking to coast. It’s for someone who wants their work to matter, someone who understands that hiring world‑class technical talent is how we achieve the impossible.

The challenge of recruiting for one of the most innovative companies in aerospace
A team that values your expertise, trusts you deeply, and has your back
The satisfaction of knowing every hire contributes to mission
If you thrive under pressure, love the hunt for exceptional technical talent, and want to work on missions that genuinely matter, let’s talk.
Please be aware that this role is fully office‑based, Monday to Friday, with no flexible or remote work arrangements.
If the above sounds like you apply now!

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace.

We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

s.h: FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY
s.t:
To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here .
Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.
Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at g.biow@rocketlabusa.com. This dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

s.h: FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY
s.t:
For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant. These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.
Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality. For more information on these Regulations, click here ITAR Regulations.
